EX-99.1 2 tm2628936d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Zenas BioPharma Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update - PDUFA target action date of May 27, 2027, following FDA acceptance of Obexelimab BLA submission for the treatment of IgG4-RD in second quarter 2026 - - Obexelimab MAA submitted to the EMA for the treatment of IgG4-RD - - New data presented at 6 th International Symposium on IgG4-Related Disease supports obexelimab’s potential role as a reversible, steroid-sparing, B-cell inhibitor for the treatment of IgG4-RD - - Obexelimab INDIGO open-label extension data to be featured in late-breaking poster at ACR Convergence 2026 - - Obexelimab global Phase 2 SunStone SLE trial topline results on track for fourth quarter 2026 - - ZB021 (oral IL-17AA/AF inhibitor) dosing ongoing in Phase 1 trial; initial clinical data expected fourth quarter 2026 - - Orelabrutinib 24-week efficacy and safety data and pharmacokinetic analysis from Phase 2 trial in RRMS presented at MSToronto2026 - - Jerald Korn appointed as Chief Legal and Strategy Officer - - Cash, cash equivalents and investments of $647.1 million as of September 30, 2026 - WALTHAM, Mass., November 5, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – Zenas BioPharma, Inc.
Following the FDA’s acceptance of our BLA in the second quarter of this year, and the recent submission of our MAA to the EMA, we remain focused on commercial readiness ahead of the potential launch.
“Across our broader pipeline, we remain on track to report topline Phase 2 SunStone data in SLE and initial Phase 1 data for our oral IL-17 inhibitor, ZB021, this quarter.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) accepted the Company’s Biologics License Application (BLA) for obexelimab for the treatment of Immunoglobulin G4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD): The BLA, which was accepted in August, is under active review by the FDA and has been assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of May 27, 2027.

Additionally, data was presented on reduced glucocorticoid-associated toxicity in patients with IgG4-RD, as well as influenza and SARS-CoV-2 vaccine seroprotection data following a treatment-free window of obexelimab in patients with IgG4-RD. · Phase 2 SunStone trial in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) topline results expected in the fourth quarter 2026: Zenas anticipates reporting topline results, including results from a biomarker subset from the Phase 2 SunStone trial in the fourth quarter of 2026.
